source: Flight 15 pre-flight seed (Ship 42 on the Starbase pad from the Space Notices rollout track; planned tower catch back at Starbase)
description: Pre-launch Ship 42 seed for Starship Flight 15. Live trajectory comes from the SpaceX public vehicle tracker (ship42) and the Space Notices ship-42 feed once published. Flight 15 plans to return Ship 42 to Starbase for a tower catch roughly 22.5 hours after liftoff.
